title: Beatrix and the Veil Revisited
author: Hazel Oyelaran
blurb: Jude Winterbourne, an exiled storm-caller, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. But when a child arrives at the door speaking a language that predates kingdoms, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must reforge a broken covenant between realms, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
